q: The Golden Mean shift is the subshift on {0,1}^ℤ that forbids the word '11'. Its entropy is:
opts: log φ where φ = (1+√5)/2 (the golden ratio)
exp: The Golden Mean shift has adjacency matrix [[1,1],[1,0]] with Perron eigenvalue φ = (1+√5)/2. Entropy = log φ ≈ 0.481. The number of admissible words of length n grows as φⁿ.
